description: One statement nests calls around some operands and not others. A sanitizer or helper call applies to the operands it wraps; the other operands, and source calls nested in a sink argument, keep their own taint.

expected.notes: escapeHtml wraps req.query.name only; bio (read from req.query.bio) is concatenated raw
the escaper wraps a constant; bio is raw in the same argument
siteHeader() returns a constant, bio is concatenated beside it
card escapes its first parameter only; b is the second
t goes through the escaped parameter
